name: street-photography-motorcycle-moment
image_purpose: Travel lifestyle post and motorcycle street-fashion visual

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic high-detail street photograph of an approved adult woman seated sideways on a red motorcycle in a sunlit European city.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult blonde woman with a messy high ponytail, confident expression, layered necklaces, striped tube top, yellow shorts, and natural summer styling. She sits sideways behind an adult motorcycle rider in a black helmet and black outfit, who checks a phone. Preserve the reference's adult subjects and safe seated pose.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 1:1 street-fashion frame with red motorcycle in foreground, woman looking toward camera, rider and phone in front, European apartment buildings, parked cars, cobblestone street, and warm golden-hour city context. Preserve visible motorcycle markings from the reference without inventing new branding.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden-hour light, soft directional shadows, realistic reflections on motorcycle paint and helmet, lively but natural urban travel atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm DSLR look, shallow depth of field, high-detail photorealism, realistic skin, denim, metal, leather, and pavement texture, subtle film grain, square composition.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic high-detail square street photograph of one approved adult blonde woman with a messy high ponytail, layered necklaces, striped tube top, and yellow shorts, seated sideways in a safe relaxed pose on a red motorcycle in a sunlit European city. An adult rider in a black helmet and black outfit sits in front checking a phone. European apartment buildings, parked cars, cobblestone street, warm golden-hour light, soft directional shadows, realistic reflections on red motorcycle paint and helmet, 85mm DSLR look, shallow depth of field, natural travel-fashion atmosphere, subtle film grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, unsafe riding, moving-vehicle danger, distorted hands, extra fingers, malformed motorcycle, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, invented logos, random text, watermark, celebrity likeness, low resolution, blur

assets.name: street-photography-motorcycle-moment.jpg
assets.usage: Use for approved adult subjects, exact outfit, red motorcycle, rider and phone, European street, visible reference markings, lighting, and composition.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve approved adult subjects, exact outfits, seated arrangement, red motorcycle and its visible reference markings, rider phone, European architecture, and golden-hour lighting. The reference is replaceable with another approved adult motorcycle travel scene while retaining safe posture and the same street-photo intent. Explicitly define replacement identities, outfits, products, logos, environment, or typography; do not invent them.
